Class SmallModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.view.smallModel.SmallModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SmallModel extends Object implements Serializable
The client-side representation of the Game Model (Small Model). It holds the local state of the game, including the cards on the board, the offer track, the player's info, and their opponents' info. This model is updated dynamically by receiving DTO changes from the server.
